metadata.title: An affine reverse Faber-Krahn inequality via information decay
metadata.abstract: We prove that every convex body $K\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ admits $S\in\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{R})$ such that $\lambda_1(SK)|K|^{2/n}\le Cn$, where $C$ is universal. For origin-symmetric bodies of volume one, the bound holds in maximal Gaussian measure position. The main step is the spectral estimate \[ \lambda_1(D)\le C(P)\bigl(n+\sqrt{n I(\nu\mid\gamma_n)}\bigr) \] for an even isotropic log-concave probability measure $\nu$ supported on a symmetric convex body $D$, with Poincaré constant at most $P$ and finite relative Fisher information. A second-order Stein estimate and an information jump under convolution give entropy decay faster than $m^{-1}$ for normalised sums. Their supports control the Gaussian measure of dilates, and a Brownian bridge expansion gives the spectral estimate. A Gaussian-weighted ground state supplies a measure whose Fisher information is bounded in terms of $\lambda_1(K)$. The square-root dependence then gives the bound of order $n$.

analysis.workSummary: 每个凸体K经某个保体积线性变换S后，首特征值满足λ1(SK)|K|^(2/n)≤Cn，C为普适常数；对称体积一凸体可取最大Gaussian测度位置。核心是偶对称、各向同性、log-concave且Poincaré常数受控的支撑测度，以相对Fisher信息的平方根控制谱。
techniques: 卷积信息跃迁与熵衰减
analysis.breakthrough: 将谱上界压到维数线性阶，并把信息论衰减与凸体的仿射谱几何联结。
analysis.limitations: 结论允许选取SL_n变换，不能当作任意原位置均有同一界；中间谱估计需要对称、各向同性、有限Fisher信息及Poincaré常数控制。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
